messages:
marta: Tiny idea  weekend micro-quest: find an obscure soundtrack (vinyl/local shop/Bandcamp) and pair it with a 2-episode mini-series rec. low pressure, high charm. whos in?
owen: love that. will try to hunt a thrift-store score. goal: something with lots of grooves and weird percussion.
harper: i'm in. pairing rec for mini-series: 'Patriot' (dark, deadpan) or 'Detectorists' if you want cozy awkwardness.
cleo: or for something short+weird: 'I May Destroy You' (intense but 4 episodes for a binge-ish plan).
vinyl-bot: Quick thrift match idea: https://bandcamp.com/album/obscure-score-example (lo-fi library music) :records:
marta: @vinyl-bot that Bandcamp link rules. would pair nicely with a rainy-commute vibe.
owen: found a tiny record with clinking glass percussion + theremin bits at a shop called "Flea & Static" downtown. prob 12 tracks, ~34mins.
harper: vote: which mini-series direction? 1) quiet & comic 2) weird & moody 3) short & punchy.
cleo: 2) weird & moody gets my vote. curious to see how library music + that tone lands.
rufus: if anyone wants a quick formatting template for the reveal: ```Title: [score name / shop or link]
Why it fits (1 line)
Pairing: [mini-series + eps to watch]
Listen note: [1-sentence mood hint]```
marta: @rufus perfect. let's keep it short. reveal thread sunday night? 7pm local?
owen: in. ill post a photo of the sleeve + a 30s clip (if the shop allowed).
harper: i'll attempt to source a Bandcamp pressing and pair it with 'Patriot' s1 eps 1-2.
cleo: RSVP: maybe. short week for me but i'll try.
vinyl-bot: Event created: "Thrift Soundtrack Scavenger & Mini-Series Pair" 1939486400 (Sun 7pm local). Reminder set 1939483200 (1hr before).
marta: lovely. rules recap: no streaming-algorithm picks (local/vinyl/Bandcamp preferred), keep writeups one-liners, post listens as MP3/shot or link if allowed.
owen: will do a tiny sleeve photo and a 20s clip using quick voice note: "driving rain, underpass reverb" as my listen note.
harper: excited. might also bring an unrelated guilty-pleasure song as a palate cleanser between reveals.
cleo: if i can't make the live reveal i'll DM my pick and read the notes in thread.
rufus: pinned the template in the event description. also set a fun micro-prize: best sleeve art wins a mystery zine from my collection.
marta: mystery zine incentive? amazing. thanks all. this feels like a tiny film-fair in slack form.
ovwn: typo but agree. :laughing:
marta: fixed. see you sunday!
